newsitem.title: FRANCE: Corsican separatists claim bomb at Juppe town hall.
newsitem.headline: Corsican separatists claim bomb at Juppe town hall.

text.p: Corsican separatists claimed responsibility on Monday for a bomb attack on French Prime Minister Alain Juppe's mayoral office in Bordeaux, which damaged the historic building but injured no one.

In a statement sent to news organisations in the Corsican capital Ajaccio, the so-called "historic wing" of the Corsican National Liberation Front (FLNC) said it carried out the attack on Saturday night.
"Claim responsibility for bomb attack at the Bordeaux city hall," the outlawed guerrilla group said in a terse statement.

The blast was an escalation of the FLNC's long-running, low-intensity struggle for greater autonomy from Paris, in reaction to a clampdown ordered by Juppe when he visited the troubled Mediterranean island in July.

Juppe ordered protection stepped up at public buildings after the Bordeaux bombing, which raised the spectre of a mainland offensive by the FLNC, following the breakdown of secret talks with the government earlier this year.

The prime minister held emergency consultations with his interior and justice ministers and his office said in a statement he had ordered reinforced security at sensitive sites in Paris and several major cities.
